paper.title: Component-weighted bias in rotation curve model selection: A proxy-chain audit of χ²-based ΔAIC statistics
paper.author: Morten Magnusson

rc_default_kpc.description: Default critical radius separating baryonic-inner from halo-outer regime

efc_screening_parameter_k.description: EFC-R fixed screening parameter calibrated on full SPARC sample with LSB weight

galaxies_no_bulge.description: Galaxies with Bbulge = 0 (no bulge component in SPARC decomposition)

spearman_full_sample.description: Spearman correlation between Bbulge and ΔAIC for all 175 SPARC galaxies

spearman_latent_regime.description: Spearman correlation in the LATENT (high-L) regime

efc_win_rate_low_bbulge.description: EFC model wins or ties among galaxies with Bbulge < 0.1

efc_win_rate_high_bbulge.description: EFC model wins or ties among galaxies with Bbulge > 0.2

equations.eq4_inner_weight_fraction_B: B = Σ_{r_i < r_c} w_i / Σ_i w_i,  w_i = σ_i⁻²
equations.eq6_bias_condition: Bbulge > 0.4 AND ΔAIC_outer has opposite sign to ΔAIC_global

rcmp_protocol.description: RCMP-compliant protocol: report ΔAIC_inner and ΔAIC_outer separately to diagnose component-weighted bias and avoid conflating baryonic-fitting flexibility with halo/modified-gravity performance.
